Hi,

Welcome to my webpage, Statistics And Stuff, where I try to post interesting things about statistics and other stuff. Many of these topics are considered to be rather rudimentary while others are a touch more sophisticated. Typically, I like to write about things that either confused me in the past, confuse me in the present, or some combination of the two.

You can get in touch at statsandstuff (at) protonmail (dot) com.
